scripts.dev: lsof -ti:3000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true && yarn workspace web dev
scripts.dev:local: concurrently "yarn workspace web dev:local" "yarn workspace api dev:local"
scripts.build: yarn workspace web build && yarn workspace api build
scripts.lint: yarn workspace web lint && (yarn workspace api lint 2>/dev/null || echo "API lint skipped (no lint script)")
scripts.lint:changed: bash -c 'web_changed=$(git diff --name-only HEAD | grep -E "\.(ts|tsx)$" | grep "^apps/web/" || true); web_staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E "\.(ts|tsx)$" | grep "^apps/web/" || true); api_changed=$(git diff --name-only HEAD | grep -E "\.(ts|js)$" | grep "^apps/api/" || true); api_staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E "\.(ts|js)$" | grep "^apps/api/" || true); if [ -n "$web_changed" ] || [ -n "$web_staged" ]; then cd apps/web && yarn lint; fi; if [ -n "$api_changed" ] || [ -n "$api_staged" ]; then (cd apps/api && yarn lint 2>/dev/null || echo "API lint skipped"); fi; if [ -z "$web_changed" ] && [ -z "$web_staged" ] && [ -z "$api_changed" ] && [ -z "$api_staged" ]; then echo "No TypeScript/JavaScript files changed"; fi'
scripts.tsc: yarn workspace web type-check && (yarn workspace api type-check 2>/dev/null || echo "API type-check skipped (no script)")
scripts.tsc:changed: bash -c 'web_changed=$(git diff --name-only HEAD | grep -E "\.(ts|tsx)$" | grep "^apps/web/" || true); web_staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E "\.(ts|tsx)$" | grep "^apps/web/" || true); api_changed=$(git diff --name-only HEAD | grep -E "\.(ts|js)$" | grep "^apps/api/" || true); api_staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E "\.(ts|js)$" | grep "^apps/api/" || true); if [ -n "$web_changed" ] || [ -n "$web_staged" ]; then cd apps/web && yarn type-check; fi; if [ -n "$api_changed" ] || [ -n "$api_staged" ]; then (cd apps/api && yarn type-check 2>/dev/null || echo "API type-check skipped"); fi; if [ -z "$web_changed" ] && [ -z "$web_staged" ] && [ -z "$api_changed" ] && [ -z "$api_staged" ]; then echo "No TypeScript/JavaScript files changed"; fi'

apps/api/**/*.{ts,js}: bash -c 'if [ -f apps/api/package.json ] && grep -q "lint" apps/api/package.json; then cd apps/api && yarn lint --fix; else echo "API lint skipped"; fi'
bash -c 'if [ -f apps/api/package.json ] && grep -q "type-check" apps/api/package.json; then cd apps/api && yarn type-check; else echo "API type-check skipped"; fi'
